issues.reason: The stated verb-paraphrase test routes 'the N of X' to the entity-attached `Of` oblique only when the head noun has its own underlying verb taking the of-NP as object; 'precursor' has none (English has no verb 'precurse'), so it is the 'capital of' / 'a tributary of the river' relational-noun case the instruction set assigns to the ordinary opaque genitive `Possession`.

defect_summary: The compliant form replaces `(Of sk_slick_1 mire_essence)` with `(Possession sk_slick_1 mire_essence)` — possessed first, opaque, covering the loose relational link without meaning ownership — leaving the other three atoms unchanged.
notes: The call is close, but the route has a consequence the instruction set names explicitly (possession questions always query the `Possession` form regardless of how the fact was stated), so the wrong route makes the link unfindable rather than merely differently worded. Everything else — witness for the definite singular, `Member` for the predicate nominal on an individual, the `mire_essence` genus — follows the instruction set.
